criteria_results.criterion_text: Two threads creating `rb-clash` concurrently leave exactly one whole
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented TestConcurrentCreate.test_parallel_create_one_succeeds_one_raises_duplicate using threading.Barrier to force genuine contention. Two threads attempt to create the same runbook_id='rb-clash' with three steps. Verified exactly one succeeds, the loser gets RunbookDuplicateError silently, and the final runbook has all 3 steps with no orphaned rows.

Implemented TestConcurrentAdvanceAndUpdate.test_advance_and_update_both_succeed using threading.Barrier to synchronize two workers: one calls advance(), the other calls update_step_status(0, passed). After both threads complete, verified that current_step_index==1 (advanced) and steps[0].status==passed (updated), confirming both writes committed under SQLite's busy_timeout serialization.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A read-only reader observes pre-commit state without the new result
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented TestReadOnlySnapshot.test_reader_observes_atomic_transitions using threading.Barrier to synchronize a writer (update_step_status with StepResult) and a read_only_connect reader. The reader observes either None (pre-commit) or the complete StepResult (post-commit), never partial data. WAL mode guarantees snapshot isolation. Verified final state always shows the complete result.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Opening the store at a non-existent / inaccessible location raises a
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented TestStoreUnavailable with two test methods: test_connect_writer_nonexistent_parent_raises_sqlite_connect_error verifies connect_writer raises SQLiteConnectError when parent directory doesn't exist; test_read_only_connect_nonexistent_file_raises_sqlite_connect_error verifies read_only_connect raises SQLiteConnectError for missing files. Both tests confirm domain-shaped error wrapping.

Implemented TestReadOnlyRefusesWrite.test_create_runbook_on_readonly_connection_refused which opens a read_only_connect connection, attempts create_runbook, and verifies it raises sqlite3.OperationalError (SQLite's readonly database enforcement). After the failed attempt, verified the runbook does not exist in the store, confirming no write occurred.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Loading from an unmigrated store is refused predictably with no
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented TestUnmigratedStoreRejected with two test methods: test_load_from_unmigrated_db_raises_operational_error verifies load_runbook raises sqlite3.OperationalError mentioning 'runbooks' table when the migration hasn't run; test_create_on_unmigrated_db_raises_operational_error verifies create_runbook similarly fails. Both tests apply only lifecycle_migrations, intentionally skipping runbook_migration to simulate an unmigrated store.

Created tests/forge/persistence/test_runbook_concurrency.py with 8 test methods across 6 test classes (TestConcurrentCreate, TestConcurrentAdvanceAndUpdate, TestReadOnlySnapshot, TestStoreUnavailable, TestReadOnlyRefusesWrite, TestUnmigratedStoreRejected). Ran the test suite 5 consecutive times; all 8 tests passed in every run (0.06-0.07s per run). No timing flakiness observed.
